scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0456-pr85: wall_clock_s=580, total_tokens=2.09M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained repository transplanted from the accepted schedule seed fixture, rekeyed to the new repository, mixing ready tasks (overlapping and disjoint resource_scope), blocked tasks, draft/unconfirmed/evaluation-non-pass/readiness-non-complete tasks, and one active lease.
required_observations: every recommended task has all depends_on satisfied (ready)
blocked, draft, unconfirmed, evaluation non-pass, and readiness non-complete tasks appear 0 times in the ready-set
no resource_scope overlaps inside a parallel batch and the active lease is respected
suggested_branch and the worktree claim command are unique per recommended task
